role: Jest snapshot of the build-user-table util spec, stored directly in `tests/`.
notes: A snapshot artifact: only its location, the review-before-refresh rule and the no-secrets rule apply.

items.text: Large summary structures may use `toMatchSnapshot()` with snapshots stored in `tests/__snapshots__/`; snapshots are refreshed only after reviewing the diff.
Specs live in a `tests/` folder next to the code under test; snapshots in `tests/__snapshots__/`.
Snapshots are updated (`-u`) only after consciously reviewing the diff.

instructions.name: Security
instructions.gate: the file carries something a security rule can bite - code, markup, configuration or data; a pure re-export barrel (only `export * from` lines) carries none of it

items.text: No secrets in the diff: API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings or private endpoints — not in code, configs, environment files, tests or comments, not even "temporarily".
